name: leaderboard-04
description: Products ranked by revenue with how far each moved in the ranking since the last period.

files.content:
import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, BlockStateRows, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { Leaderboard, LeaderboardItem, LeaderboardLabel, LeaderboardRank, LeaderboardRankChange, LeaderboardValue, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/leaderboard' import { formatCurrency, formatNumber, joinDetails, } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' interface Product { category: string /** Places moved since the last period, or `new` for a first entry. */ change: number | 'new' id: number name: string revenue: number unitsSold: number } interface Leaderboard4Props { currency?: string /** Defaults to a sentence about the biggest climber and new entries. */ description?: string /** Names the last period in the sentence, such as `last week`. */ period?: string /** Leave out, or pass none, to show the empty state. */ products?: Product[] status?: BlockStatus title: string } const exampleProps: Leaderboard4Props = { currency: 'USD', period: 'last week', products: [ { id: 1, name: 'Studio Monitor 27"', category: 'Displays', revenue: 48_920, unitsSold: 112, change: 1, }, { id: 2, name: 'Wireless Headphones', category: 'Audio', revenue: 41_370, unitsSold: 287, change: -1, }, { id: 3, name: 'Ergonomic Chair', category: 'Furniture', revenue: 36_540, unitsSold: 84, change: 0, }, { id: 4, name: 'Mechanical Keyboard', category: 'Peripherals', revenue: 22_815, unitsSold: 169, change: 3, }, { id: 5, name: 'Desk Lamp Pro', category: 'Lighting', revenue: 14_260, unitsSold: 203, change: 'new', }, { id: 6, name: 'Precision Mouse', category: 'Peripherals', revenue: 9_880, unitsSold: 152, change: -2, }, ], title: 'Top products', } const ordinalRules = new Intl.PluralRules('en-US', { type: 'ordinal' }) const ordinalSuffix: Record = { few: 'rd', one: 'st', two: 'nd' } const ordinal = (rank: number) => `${rank}${ordinalSuffix[ordinalRules.select(rank)] ?? 'th'}` function summarize(products: Product[], period: string) { const climber = products .map((product, index) => ({ ...product, rank: index + 1 })) .filter((product) => typeof product.change === 'number' && product.change > 0) .sort((a, b) => (b.change as number) - (a.change as number))[0] const fresh = products.filter((product) => product.change === 'new') const parts = [ climber && `${climber.name} climbed ${climber.change} ${climber.change === 1 ? 'place' : 'places'} to ${ordinal(climber.rank)}`, fresh.length === 1 && `${fresh[0].name} is new`, fresh.length > 1 && `${fresh.length} products are new`, ].filter(Boolean) return parts.length > 0 ? `${parts.join(' and ')} since ${period}.` : `No changes in the ranking since ${period}.` } const Leaderboard4 = (props: Leaderboard4Props) => { const { currency = 'USD', period = 'the last period', products = [], status, title, } = props const state = getBlockState(status, products.length === 0) const { description = summarize(products, period) } = props return (

{title}

{description}
# Product Revenue Move
{!state && ( {products.map((product, index) => (

{product.name}

{joinDetails( product.category, `${formatNumber(product.unitsSold)} sold`, )}

{formatCurrency(product.revenue, { currency })}
))} )}
) } export { Leaderboard4, exampleProps as leaderboard4ExampleProps, type Leaderboard4Props, type Product, }
